title: Have you been to this forest?
content: Has anyone been here before? Or have any knowledge of this place? A bit of background- I have been unconsciously projecting for the better part of my life. It has always happened off and on and I do not have much control over it. When I actively try, I’m not able. So, when it does happen I am always taken notes. Most of the time I just dream. I can easily tell the difference because when I astral project, I am conscious and processing the environment around me. I can hear, smell, and have an internal dialogue. I’m always alone as well. The last time it happened, I ended up in this almost endless forest. It was dark but just as if it were nighttime. The trees were large and most of the trunks were almost twisted. Although it was very forest like (having trees placed randomly in no order) all of the trees connected with one another creating almost like a canopy. It wasn’t a solid canopy though. There were different size “eye shaped” windows some of the branches would create so that you could see the sky through the “canopy”. Every “window” was like an eye shape, but they were all different sizes. It’s so hard to explain. From where I was standing in this area I was standing at the edge of a small circular clearing in this forest like place. The ground looked like a mixture of dirt and reddish clay. In front of me were (this is the best way I can describe it) evenly spaced stone slabs. There were 6 of them. Three in one row and three in another. They were perfectly cut stone slabs. I would say they were about 4ft wide and 6ft long. They almost looked shiny like marble, but it was a uniform grey. They were thick. Probably about 36 inches. They were not flat on the ground. They hovered about 2- 4 inches off of the ground. The place felt familiar. I felt as if these slabs were used for something and their users were just not there at the time. I never felt scared, uneasy, or like I shouldn’t be there. It was confusing because I felt like I SHOULD know where I was or was supposed to know but I just couldn’t remember. If you read that far, thank you for sticking with me. Let me know if you have any thoughts. I appreciate it.
